## Data & Research Trainings

> To overcome the fear of coding & numbers

<br>

- 07 Non-profit^1^ trainings held with +100 participants (female 60%).

- 5 days, offline, in Dr. Ambedkar Bhawan, Sonipat (HR).

- Majority PhD students, first time coders, 99% from marginalised community.

- Invited international pro bono guest speakers.

::: {.aside}
^1^ Participants pay only for their food and accommodation.
:::

## Sep 2027 Offline Level 1

> First Offline Batch of Level 1 (6-8 classes)

- 03 months residential level 1 course at SARA, Dr. Ambedkar Bhawan, Sonipat.

- 100 students (50 female) priority admission for marginal communities & women.

- Plan funds to provide accommodation and food for 100 days.

- Need pro bono teachers & slides.

## June 2028 Internships

<br>

- Data & research related summer & winter internships

- Need more planning how SARA can have its own project.


## 2029 Conference

> 3 Jan Mata Savitribai's Birth Anniversary 

- Inviting scholars to present papers.

- Inviting young students to interact with the scholars.

- Award budding scholars from marginalised communities.

:::

<br>
<br>

- Land at least 500 Gaj (approx 5000 Sq foot) in Delhi NCR

- Two dormitories (each with 50 capacity beds)

## Let's Discuss! 

1. [What else should be added to our Data School curriculum?]{.rn-fragment}

1. [Should SARA also approach organizations for sponsorships?]{.rn-fragment}

1. [Should Bridge Course classes be live-streamed on YouTube directly,<br> or held on Zoom first and uploaded to YouTube afterward?]{.rn-fragment}

1. [Would you be interested in teaching pro bono, or do you know someone who might be?]{.rn-fragment}

1. [Should SARA buy its own land to build a permanent space?]{.rn-fragment}

1. [What else should SARA be thinking about (as an organization)?]{.rn-fragment}
